Notebook name: rects_family_geoms.ipynb

Rects Family Geoms — xkcd renderer¶

All of the geoms below render axis-aligned rectangles. On the iter8-merge-rects branch they were unified to draw through a single, intent-named helper (SvgRectHelper) behind a pluggable Renderer. This notebook draws every geom in the family with the xkcd renderer (hand-drawn style), so the whole family can be checked through the non-default rendering path in one pass.

The xkcd renderer is selected via the theme renderer option and requires a Lets-Plot build whose JS bundle includes it (the iter8-merge-rects dev build). A released package will draw these plots in the plain style.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


from lets_plot import *
In [2]:
LetsPlot.setup_html()

Enable the xkcd renderer for every plot¶

In [3]:
# The xkcd renderer is chosen through the theme `renderer` option. The Python
# theme() wrapper does not expose `renderer` yet, so build the theme spec
# directly and set it globally — every plot below is drawn with it.
from lets_plot.plot.core import FeatureSpec

LetsPlot.set_theme(FeatureSpec('theme', name=None, renderer='xkcd'))

Prepare data¶

In [4]:
mpg = pd.read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JetBrains/lets-plot-docs/master/data/mpg.csv')

# Summary stats per drive type (for the *range / *bar geoms).
summary = mpg.groupby('drv')['hwy'].agg(['mean', 'std']).reset_index()
summary['ymin'] = summary['mean'] - summary['std']
summary['ymax'] = summary['mean'] + summary['std']

# Smooth 2D field (for geom_tile / geom_raster).
grid = np.linspace(-3, 3, 50)
X, Y = np.meshgrid(grid, grid)
Z = np.exp(-(X**2 + Y**2) / 2)
field = {'x': X.flatten(), 'y': Y.flatten(), 'z': Z.flatten()}

# Explicit rectangle corners (for geom_rect).
rects = pd.DataFrame({
    'xmin': [0.0, 1.5, 3.0],
    'xmax': [1.0, 2.5, 4.0],
    'ymin': [0.0, 0.5, 1.0],
    'ymax': [1.0, 2.0, 1.5],
    'g': ['a', 'b', 'c'],
})

summary

geom_rect()¶

ggplot(rects) + \
    geom_rect(aes(xmin='xmin', xmax='xmax', ymin='ymin', ymax='ymax', fill='g'),
              alpha=.5, color='black')

Overview grid¶

In [15]:
p_rect = ggplot(rects) + geom_rect(aes(xmin='xmin', xmax='xmax', ymin='ymin', ymax='ymax', fill='g'), alpha=.5, color='black') + ggtitle('geom_rect')
p_tile = ggplot(field, aes('x', 'y')) + geom_tile(aes(fill='z')) + ggtitle('geom_tile')
p_bin2d = ggplot(mpg, aes('cty', 'hwy')) + geom_bin2d() + ggtitle('geom_bin2d')
p_bar = ggplot(mpg, aes(x='class', fill='drv')) + geom_bar() + ggtitle('geom_bar')
p_cross = ggplot(summary, aes(x='drv')) + geom_crossbar(aes(ymin='ymin', y='mean', ymax='ymax', fill='drv')) + ggtitle('geom_crossbar')
p_pr = ggplot(summary, aes(x='drv', y='mean')) + geom_pointrange(aes(ymin='ymin', ymax='ymax', color='drv')) + ggtitle('geom_pointrange')

gggrid([p_rect, p_tile, p_bin2d, p_bar, p_cross, p_pr], ncol=2)
